facts.fact: The African Development Bank says the Mindelo Technology Park, inaugurated 6 May 2025, includes a business incubation hub and a training centre, with no incubation programme or cohort described.

The African Development Bank says the Mindelo Technology Park, a special digital economic zone, hosts ten companies from four countries and 125 employees, with 80% of 25 office spaces occupied, and both TechPark CV campuses are operational.
